result: FAIL: 13 subtests across the frozen Gate 0 tests, one root cause
rootCause: The recorded executions of UE-CAP-F-001, UE-CAP-H-001, UE-CAP-H-005, UE-CAP-K-001 and UE-CAP-K-002 in docs/union-eyes/convergence/evidence/gate0-source-verification.json name hash-pinned log files under docs/union-eyes/convergence/evidence/gate0-source-verification/*.log. Those logs are not in the repository: **/*.log is git-ignored, git history contains no such file, and no other worktree or session folder holds them. executionEvidenceProblems() therefore reports "no recorded output" for each.
whyNotRepaired: The logs carry timestamps and durations from the 2026-10-26 run and cannot be regenerated byte for byte, and writing new records would rewrite frozen Gate 0 history, which the mission forbids. Nothing was fabricated, weakened or skipped.
decisionNeeded: Either recover the original logs from the machine that produced them (their sha256 values are in the records), or the owner accepts the loss and authorises a NEW execution-evidence tranche recorded at a later commit (not an edit of the frozen record).
preventRecurrence: A .gitignore exception now lets execution-evidence logs under gate0-source-verification/ be committed.
